description: Chosen-input subspace attack on the main checkpoint (a = 1, noise off). The attacker runs the same transform on its own prompts, estimates the displacement subspace from the observed Z - E, projects intercepted vectors onto its orthogonal complement and decodes by nearest neighbour in the public embedding table. Measured on the FP32 transform outputs, before the bf16 conversion for delivery.
note: Without the attack, nearest-neighbour decoding recovers 1,229 of 2,794 content tokens (56.0% hidden, pooled over tokens). The paper quotes the macro rate on the same set (mean over prompts), 59.7%.
